what_it_is.prose: Big Bang Boom Solutions Private Limited (BBBS) is a Chennai-based defence-tech startup founded to develop indigenous counter-UAS and electronic warfare solutions. The company has raised $31.65 million across three funding rounds, with a ₹250 crore Series B in September 2024 at 15x return to early investors — making BBBS what press coverage termed 'India's first defence dragon' (the highest-valued defence-tech startup). BBBS's flagship product is the Vajra Sentinel Counter-Drone System (Atlas slug cus-009), which uses AI-powered passive RF sensor technology and received a ₹200 crore MoD contract on 8 March 2024 under the iDEX (Innovations for Defence Excellence) framework — a joint IAF and Indian Army order. The first lot of Vajra Sentinel systems was delivered to the Indian Air Force around May 2025, with delivery accelerated in response to Operation Sindoor. The broader Vajra product family includes Vajra Shot (handheld anti-drone gun, used by the National Security Guard), Vajra Spot (AESA drone detection radar), Vajra Shield X and S (jammers), Vajra Super Shot (jammer), Vajra Sight/Strike/Slayer (kinetic effectors), and Vajra Scan X/S and Sense (detection systems). BBBS also produces an EW portfolio (Cnidaria, Aqua Tether, Yudhikshana, Agni, Quell, TIC Drone) and AI-powered Command & Control (C2) systems. BBBS is a SKOCH Award winner. NOTE: BBBS is NOT the maker of Bhargavastra (which is Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited / SDAL of Nagpur) — the Atlas register previously conflated these two distinct Indian counter-drone products; see REGISTER_TICKETS.md ticket P0-BHARGAVASTRA-MAKER.

faq.question: Is BBBS the maker of Bhargavastra?
faq.answer: No. Bhargavastra is made by Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited (SDAL) of Nagpur — a subsidiary of Solar Group / Solar Industries India Limited. The Atlas register previously conflated BBBS with Bhargavastra — see REGISTER_TICKETS.md ticket P0-BHARGAVASTRA-MAKER. BBBS's actual counter-drone product is the Vajra Sentinel (Atlas slug cus-009), which uses AI-powered passive RF technology and has a ₹200 cr MoD contract (March 2024).

faq.question: What is 'India's first defence dragon'?
faq.answer: BBBS was termed 'India's first defence dragon' by Business Standard (ANI) in September 2024 when the company raised a ₹250 crore Series B funding round at 15x return to early investors. The 'dragon' designation (a play on 'unicorn') refers to BBBS being the highest-valued defence-tech startup in India at that time. Total funding raised across three rounds is $31.65 million.

faq.question: What products does BBBS make beyond Vajra Sentinel?
faq.answer: The Vajra product family includes Sentinel (C-UAS, the flagship), Shot (handheld anti-drone gun used by NSG), Spot (AESA drone detection radar), Shield X and S (jammers), Super Shot (jammer), Sight/Strike/Slayer (kinetic effectors), and Scan X/S and Sense (detection systems). BBBS also produces an EW portfolio (Cnidaria, Aqua Tether, Yudhikshana, Agni, Quell, TIC Drone) and AI-powered Command & Control (C2) systems.
